title: ArchWall and ArchStairs proxy state lose ArchSketch fields across dumps/loads
description:
Source-only follow-up discovered while fixing FreeCAD-0ie; no native ArchWall/ArchStairs runtime, saved-document, or installed SketchArch addon reproduction has been performed for this issue.

Expected: both stock proxies preserve ArchSkPropSetPickedUuid and ArchSkPropSetListPrev through their own dumps/loads and saved FCStd cold-open/save round trips, retaining supported historical state compatibility.

Source evidence at HEAD fbde6e31784e15305ead282660370c142dce76d1:
- src/Mod/BIM/ArchComponent.py:427-431: Component.dumps returns None; Component.loads only sets Type.
- src/Mod/BIM/ArchWall.py:138: _Wall inherits Component directly. Lines 408-411 initialize UUID="" and previous-property-set list=[]. Lines 414-419 wrap the parent None as (None,) and append both fields, emitting (None, uuid, previous_property_sets). Lines 421-432 handle historical "Wall"-prefixed state correctly, but route current None-prefixed state to indices 0/1, assigning UUID=None and previous-property-set list=uuid while dropping the actual list.
- src/Mod/BIM/ArchStairs.py:61: _Stairs inherits Component directly. Lines 551-554 initialize the same fields. Lines 556-561 emit the same current tuple. Lines 563-574 route None-prefixed state to the same incorrect indices 0/1.

Source-level consequence: both default (None,"",[]) and nonempty (None,"selected-uuid",["Default","Variant"]) dumps states are decoded at the wrong positions. JSON converts these tuples to lists without changing that indexing. This follows from inspected code; it is not a claim of exercised native serialization or geometry corruption.

Compatibility scope: establish and preserve documented/supportable None, historical raw type-string, type-prefixed sequence, and legacy two-item UUID/list state formats; include UUIDs starting with W/S and matching Wall/Stairs where supported so type-marker dispatch does not silently lose fields.

Known scope: serialization contract mismatch in two stock BIM proxies. Actual behavior of configured SketchArch/ArchSketch property-set variants, renamed selections, and geometry after reopen/recompute remains unqualified. Qualify with the real supported addon before claiming variant or geometry impact. No source patch, monkeypatch, or fixture repair has been applied for Wall/Stairs.
acceptance_criteria: Add focused native regression coverage for current dumps/loads tuples and JSON lists with default and nonempty UUID/list values for both Wall and Stairs; verify saved FCStd cold reopen and another save preserve those fields. Preserve supported historical state formats with explicit compatibility tests. Verify fresh default objects and restored nonempty state do not regress ordinary stock behavior. Establish actual variant behavior with the real supported SketchArch/ArchSketch addon, recording version and evidence; do not infer geometry corruption from serialization alone.
notes:
Resolved on 4 October 2026, based on merged f9d47f9b7096c06535150e6cf577fdb7b57111ed. Native FreeCADCmd 27.1.0devR49060 with repository BIM/Draft reproduced both stock default proxies shifting (None, '', []) to (None, None, ''). Eight regressions were run red first: current tuple/JSON states lost UUID/list, bare W/S identifiers skipped fields, and bare Wall/Stairs identifiers raised IndexError. None and exact scalar type compatibility passed.

Loaders now return for None or the exact legacy scalar type name, decode recognized three-slot None/type-prefixed states at indices 1/2, and retain bare two-slot UUID/list decoding. Arity disambiguates marker-like identifiers. Local history confirms Wall bare state from d973e3428f, tagged state from 6a92b77632; Stairs tagged state and bare compatibility from 356d89f1bb; parent state became None at d8889c3ca4.

All 8 focused regressions and full native Wall/Stairs suites (29 tests) pass. Built BIM target then verified build/release/bin/FreeCADCmd -t TestArch.TestArchWall -t TestArch.TestArchStairs. All applicable pre-commit hooks and whitespace checks pass. Independent compatibility/implementation review approved without findings. Separate native processes also preserve default and populated fields through FCStd cold reopen, resave, another reopen and forced recompute with unchanged valid geometry/volumes.

Real addon qualification: paullee0/FreeCAD_SketchArch commit e81620a8933cd59dfe8bf217c49b534bd21ccd0e; actual ArchSketch Sketcher::SketchObjectPython with wallAxis/flightAxis roles selects either a 1000 mm line at X=0 or Compact variant 71451e63-59a1-45e5-a752-ddd9135f38e6, a 400 mm line at X=2000. Unchanged-name recompute repairs both proxies. Rename selected set before first recompute: baseline chooses Default and changes Wall volume 24000000 -> 60000000 mm^3 (X=2000 -> 0), Stairs volume 3413565.1940746503 -> 8252652.77777778 mm^3 (X=2000 -> 0). Fixed loaders preserve UUID/cache immediately on open and retain renamed selection, compact volumes and complete bounds; Wall has one solid, Stairs four. Both Default and nonempty variants passed assertions on state, enum, valid/nonempty shape, solid count, volume and all bounds. Five logs contain ASSERTIONS_PASS with no traceback.

Headless accommodations only suppress absent GUI command/dock registration and omit ArchSketch ViewObject.Proxy=0 initialization; actual addon geometry, state, restore and onChanged methods are unchanged. No GUI-rendering or generalized geometry-corruption claim. No Oomakhi edits or project acceptance claims; originating model qualification remains separate. title: Investigate empty closepath operations in native TechDraw PDFs
description:
Native TechDraw PDF exports retained during Oomakhi BIM drawing work contain empty closepath/fill operations and trigger Poppler "No current point in closepath" diagnostics. File as a bug with investigation scope: the observed output is evidenced; the responsible native child and FreeCAD-versus-Qt cause are unresolved.

Expected: ordinary TechDraw Export Page as PDF produces valid path operations without these parser diagnostics and preserves all visible drawing content.

Runtime evidence: exported PDF metadata identifies FreeCAD 27.1.0dev TechDraw and Qt 6.11.2. A retained FreeCAD 1.1.3/Qt 6.8.3 comparison has zero empty closepath/fill operations. The exact source commit used for each earlier export is not established by this report; current source inspection is at 85069f13d3edd995e84f354286c6226203644905. Version comparison alone does not isolate a Qt regression.

Observed: R30 A501 proof and an R31 hatch-hidden control each contain four bare h/f operations with no preceding path coordinates. The control does not establish a hatch cause. Later ordinary GUI TechDraw_ExportPagePDF exports also retain the diagnostics. No lost drawing ink has been demonstrated; visual acceptance and PDF syntax are separate checks.

Reproduction for the separate session: open the retained native page source identified by the evidence record, refresh it using stock FreeCAD controls, use ordinary TechDraw Export Page as PDF, then render/check with Poppler and inspect the reported content-stream paths. Preserve the exported bytes. Isolate the emitting native child and make a minimal document before proposing a fix. A minimal reproducer remains outstanding.

Evidence repository https://github.com/onobumba/oomakhi.git (available at commit 43423a05; local root /Users/zukomgwili/src/oomakhi):
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r30/pdf-warning-content-preflight.json pins comparison files, operator indices, hashes and parent view contexts.
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r30/gui-qualified/A501-hatch-proof.pdf SHA256 1c62fd7b2c7208b9398f78ab9b0caddad03f97f1298913314d20474d5854f63d.
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r31/diagnostics/A501-no-new-hatch.pdf SHA256 d719fe7f7656369656832514e44e14c0b8609b92824837964ae04e77ed91c325.
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r33/gui-final/A102.pdf SHA256 a2a1c68fe72161562eca2bec2ad2363059aff6f7b11b9e1106d4f77c5564fb0e; diagnostics at artifacts/BIM-Transition/r33/gui-final/A102-render.stderr and visual review at artifacts/BIM-Transition/r33/A102-independent-visual-review.json.
- Originating bead oomakhi-q9f.5.15 retains warning-free production qualification; source issue filing does not close it.

Source lead only: src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/QGIViewPart.cpp around line 425 constructs projected-edge painter paths without an emptiness check. This is not an isolated emitting path or proven cause. No source patch, PDF stream repair or custom renderer was applied. Source diagnosis/implementation is deferred to a separate session.
acceptance_criteria: Isolate the emitting native child/path and runtime conditions, establish FreeCAD versus Qt responsibility and retain a minimal stock reproducer. A supported stock export must be warning-free under the retained PDF checks and independently preserve visible drawing content. Do not claim a hatch cause or lost ink without evidence.
notes:
Resolved at source on codex/fix-techdraw-empty-pdf-paths, based on 239239de4f12b3c44767b1c11590fe972e6ccf32.

Isolated emitter: QGIViewDimension constructs a framed areaLeaderPointLabel for each dimension, including non-Area dimensions. Its QGIDatumLabel frame is a default QGraphicsRectItem with a null QRectF. With translucent NormalColor (0x000000D8), Qt PDF outlining emits a bare h f for this zero-size frame. Frame ancestry/transform matches the retained PDF operations. A minimal native box/view/Distance document emits one warning; hiding only its null frame before the same stock export removes it. A501 contains 159 nonempty projected QGIEdge paths, so the projected-edge source lead was not the cause. Area also retains a null frame; hiding only non-Area labels is insufficient.

Responsibility: an unmodified QGraphicsRectItem with null or translated-null rectangle, translucent pen and NoBrush reproduces in Qt 6.8.3 and 6.11.2. QPdf::Stroker::strokePath appends h f without checking that a coordinate was emitted (qtbase src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp:649-656 in both tags). This is not established as a Qt-version regression. A separate nonempty line wholly within a translucent dashed gap also exposes the Qt outline condition; qualification is tracked in FreeCAD-hii and no stock FreeCAD reproduction or missing ink is claimed for it.

Fix: route datum frames through existing QGCustomRect; return from paint only when rect().isNull(). Bounds, shapes, placement and datum interactions remain unchanged. One-axis zero dimensions and negative-sized rectangles remain paintable; isEmpty() would incorrectly suppress them.

Retained minimal stock reproducer: tests/src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/EmptyDimensionFrame.FCMacro, with optional Area. It restores changed preferences and uses physical widths before the stock Python PDF export, matching the ordinary GUI wrapper's ScreenMode=false. An initial diagnostic API export omitted that wrapper state and used oversized screen-scaled strokes; those fixtures were superseded by readable physical-mode red/green exports. No PDF stream repair or custom renderer was used.

Final native validation (Qt 6.11.2, Poppler 26.09.0): A501 bare closepaths/Poppler warnings 4/4 -> 0/0, A102 40/40 -> 0/0. Both controlled physical-mode renders are exactly RGB-identical at 2384x1684. Distance and theoretical-exact controls 1 -> 0; Area+exact and relocated Area+exact controls 2 -> 0; all four renders exactly RGB-identical at 842x595. Theoretical-exact nonnull frame and text remain visible; Area measures 100 mm2 and its relocated leader/text remain visible. Original FCStd sources and validation copies remain unchanged.

Final actual Gui.runCommand('TechDraw_ExportPagePDF') uses the stock MDI page and Export Page as PDF dialog, produces 0 bare closes/0 warnings with readable framed 10 mm dimension, and restores ScreenMode=true. Final committed manual macro with optional Area produces both PDFs with 0/0 diagnostics. All isolated native processes ended.

Quality gates: TechDrawGui and QGCustomRect_Tests_run build; recording-paint-engine QtTest compiles actual production source, fails both null cases before fix and passes after fix, while ordinary/horizontal/vertical/negative cases preserve rect, pen and brush. Final CTest target passes. Existing full TestTechDrawGui 11/11 and DimensionSuite 2/2 pass. Applicable pre-commit hooks, macro syntax and git diff --check pass. Independent source/test review found no actionable findings. Independent pypdf/Poppler/RGB/visual review approves readable geometry, text, hatch, dimensions, leader arrows and positive frame controls across all six pairs.

Scratch evidence: /tmp/freecad-k3b-native/validation (print-red/print-green and stock-command-print-final-green), /tmp/freecad-k3b-debug/final-independent-print-comparison.json, /tmp/freecad-k3b-ctest-final.log. Drawing-content regression acceptance only: no hatch cause or lost ink is claimed; Oomakhi production qualification bead oomakhi-q9f.5.15 remains separate and unchanged.
close_reason: Null datum-frame emitter isolated and fixed; stock PDF export is warning-free with independently preserved visible drawing content.

title: Qualify Qt PDF empty outlines outside the TechDraw dash guard
description:
Discovered while completing FreeCAD-hii. The underlying Qt PDF stroker defect remains in unmodified Qt 6.8.3 and 6.11.2. The bounded FreeCAD mitigation omits only an empty dashed outline from a translucent SolidPattern, positive-width noncosmetic pen, with NoBrush, TransparentMode and affine transform, on a recognized non-PDF/A PDF device. It does not change fills, cosmetic/hairline pens, opaque backgrounds or perspective painting.

Known Qt-only empty-outline cases beyond that guard need a correction at the actual Qt serializer boundary. In particular, an all-gap dashed foreground in OpaqueMode can coexist with a visible solid background stroke; a whole-item omission would destroy that ink. Public stroker preflight also differs for cosmetic pens under scaling and Qt PDF zero/tiny-width substitutions. Opaque pens and PDF/A-1b are preservation controls, not established malformed outputs: their native PDF route can turn a zero-length custom dash into visible ink even when a public outline is empty.

Proposed universal Qt correction: in QPdf::Stroker::strokePath, append terminal h f only when existing first flag is false after the actual stroker callback. moveToHook clears that flag when it emits a coordinate. Source audit supports preserving every existing coordinated outline, but a patched Qt library has not been built or tested. Primary sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qt/qtbase/v6.11.2/src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qt/qtbase/v6.8.3/src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp .

Retained Qt-only script tests/src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/qt_pdf_dashed_gap_repro.py provides the all-gap red case and visible/opaque/PDF-A controls. Scratch wider probes are /tmp/freecad-k3b-qt/native_clamp_probe.py and the FreeCAD-hii investigation. No supported stock TechDraw reproduction is established for the excluded modes. No external Qt report has been submitted.
acceptance_criteria: Validate a Qt-side correction against actual empty and coordinated stroke output, including visible fill/background ink, cosmetic transforms and zero/tiny-width normalization. Retain reproducible cases and independent syntax/render checks; determine the supported Qt delivery path. Do not suppress visible geometry or treat opaque/PDF-A preservation controls as bugs.

Qualified the actual Qt-side serializer correction on branch codex/qualify-qt-pdf-stroker, stacked on unmerged FreeCAD-hii commit 8ff248985a7ced2d8903f393bfb3a7cf596f1344. FreeCAD production guards and installed Qt remain unchanged.

Retained tests/src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/QtPdfStroker contains the two-line Qt patch, standalone C++ QPdfWriter generator, strict pypdf/Poppler/Pillow comparator, reproduction/delivery README and source/runtime/per-case qualification.json. The fixture does not copy the serializer or rewrite PDFs. The existing PySide gap command still independently goes red on installed Qt 6.11.2, as expected.

title: Qualify Qt PDF empty outlines for translucent dashed gaps
description:
Discovered during FreeCAD-k3b investigation. Independent, unmodified Qt PDF exports reproduce an empty stroke outline even when the input QPainterPath is nonempty: line (100,100) -> (100.01,100), QColor(0,0,0,128), noncosmetic width 2, FlatCap, CustomDashLine pattern [1,5], dash offset 2, NoBrush. The line lies wholly in a dash gap. Qt 6.8.3 and Qt 6.11.2 both emit a bare h f and Poppler 26.09.0 reports No current point in closepath. Path.isEmpty() is false; an empty-input guard cannot solve this separate condition.

Qt primary source: QPdf::Stroker::strokePath in src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp lines649-656 unconditionally appends h f after stroking, even when no coordinate callback occurs. Both versions have the same behavior: https://github.com/qt/qtbase/blob/v6.11.2/src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp#L649-L656 and https://github.com/qt/qtbase/blob/v6.8.3/src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp#L649-L656 . Scratch asserted reproducer /tmp/freecad-k3b-qt/repro.py gap, with standalone Pixi Python3.13/PySide6 and /Applications/FreeCAD.app/Contents/Resources/bin/python respectively.

No stock TechDraw dashed-gap reproduction or missing ink has been established. This is separate from the proven zero-size area-label frame in FreeCAD-k3b. Do not discard valid short projected geometry or change dash semantics as a workaround. No external Qt report has been sent.
acceptance_criteria: Retain a minimal Qt-only reproducer, establish whether supported stock TechDraw can encounter this condition, and determine an appropriate Qt correction or bounded FreeCAD mitigation without suppressing visible nonempty geometry. Record versions and independent PDF/visible-content checks.
notes:
Completed with a bounded FreeCAD mitigation on codex/qualify-qt-dashed-gap-pdf, based on merged k3b main 3cdca561ceba9d6138904303623269714faf2ea8.

Re-established the original Qt-only red case on Qt 6.8.3 and 6.11.2: nonempty line (100,100)->(100.01,100), noncosmetic width 2, alpha 128, FlatCap, dash [1,5], offset 2, NoBrush. One bare closepath and Poppler No current point in closepath; Poppler exits0, so stderr/operator checks are required. Retained standalone diagnostic tests/src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/qt_pdf_dashed_gap_repro.py exits1 for this unmodified Qt defect and includes visible-dash/solid/offset-zero and opaque/PDF-A native-clamp controls. Round/Square all-gap variants also reproduce. No PDF rewriting or external report was used.

Supported stock TechDraw reproduction is established through actual GUI choices and TechDraw_ExportPagePDF: shipped ASME Y14.2.2008 Viewing-plane style 10 starts with Space 12. LineGenerator::getLinePen skips that element and sets offset 12, pattern [12,12,12,12,24,12]. A FreeCAD cosmetic edge from (20,20) to (20.01,20) mm, width 0.2 mm, alpha 128, FlatCap produces a nonempty two-element QGIEdge path of 0.1 scene units with pen width 2, offset 12 and Qt pen.isCosmetic=false. Two unpatched native exports each produce one bare h f and one warning. An opaque short-gap and box-only render are equal with zero warnings; short solid and 10 mm dashed controls have visible ink and zero warnings.

Root cause remains Qt QPdf::Stroker::strokePath's unconditional terminal h f when no stroke coordinates were emitted. Official tagged sources reset first=true and moveToHook clears it when a coordinate is serialized. A conditional terminal write if(!first) is the broader Qt correction; it has not been applied or compiled here. Primary sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qt/qtbase/v6.11.2/src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qt/qtbase/v6.8.3/src/gui/painting/qpdf.cpp . Remaining Qt-side/excluded-mode qualification is FreeCAD-34z, discovered-from this issue.

FreeCAD fix: introduce QGCustomPath as the QGIPrimPath base. It omits painting only when the actual pen generates an empty public stroked outline in the proven direct PDF branch: NoBrush, translucent SolidPattern pen, dashed, noncosmetic, width>=0.0001, TransparentMode, affine world transform, recognized QPdfWriter/QPrinter PDF engine excluding PDF/A-1b. All other cases use unchanged QGraphicsPathItem::paint. Model path, pen, brush, bounds, shape and picking remain intact; QGIPrimPath still masks selected painting and installs its current style before delegating.

Scope restrictions were independently audited and tested, rather than inferred from input emptiness. A 138-case matrix per Qt version found parity for all 96 tested noncosmetic positive-width cases; cosmetic scaling and zero/tiny-width substitutions differ. Opaque and PDF/A native dashes clamp zero-length dash[0,5] into visible ink even when public outline is empty: both tested Qt versions render 1,170 ink pixels in the retained diagnostic controls. OpaqueMode can retain a visible solid background stroke; perspective invokes Qt emulation. These branches fall through. Fills and unknown PDF devices also fall through. This does not claim a universal Qt or PDF fix.

Retained manual macro tests/src/Mod/TechDraw/Gui/ShortDashedGap.FCMacro uses the actual GUI standard/style task, editable public cosmetic geometry and color API, then stock export. It pins shipped line-definition/element directories, Flat caps, physical widths and PDF 1.4, and restores changed preferences. Portability smoke seeded nonexistent custom style directories, prior ANSI selection and PDF/A preference; export was PDF 1.4 and all preferences restored. Cosmetic-edge FCStd persistence stores RGB only, so the macro reconstructs translucent state; a retained-load public alpha reapplication was also tested. Original red FCStd/PDF bytes remain unchanged.

Final fixed native validation: actual GUI short-gap warning/bare-close counts 1 -> 0; other four controls remain 0. All five red/green RGB arrays exactly equal at 300 dpi (3509 x 2480). The gap remains intentionally without stroke ink; box, short solid and long dashed ink bounds are preserved. Retained-load and final manual macro exports have zero warnings. Existing Distance/Exact/Area/relocatedArea controls remain warning-free and pixel-identical to prior physical k3b green. Full TestTechDrawGui 11/11 passes. All isolated native processes ended.

Quality gates: TechDrawGui, QGCustomPath_Tests_run and QGCustomRect_Tests_run built. New recording-engine tests compile actual production source: four gap rows fail before the guard; final paint cases pass, preserving geometry/style/bounds/shape for visible, filled, opaque/PDF-A, cosmetic/tiny-width, background, perspective and non-PDF cases. Final CTest both path/rectangle targets pass. Applicable pre-commit hooks, explicit new-source clang-format, macro syntax and git diff --check pass. Independent source/test review and strict pypdf/Poppler/300dpi pixel/visual review have no outstanding findings.

Evidence: /tmp/freecad-hii-native (stock-red3/green, retained-load, manual-green), /tmp/freecad-hii-review/independent-final-comparison.json, /tmp/freecad-hii-ctest-red.log and /tmp/freecad-hii-ctest-final.log. This source/stock-export regression acceptance does not change Oomakhi production qualification.
close_reason: Stock ASME dashed-gap emitter reproduced and bounded PDF paint guard verified; warnings removed with independent pixel-identical visible-content checks.

title: Initialize or document Draft line endpoints before expression attachment
description:
Enhancement/investigation proposal: make the initialization timing of Draft line Start/End metadata explicit and safe for supported expression attachment, either through documented ordering or a compatible constructor improvement. This is not a confirmed FreeCAD regression.

Observed authoring error: Oomakhi R42 attached component Z expressions to a newly constructed Draft.make_line before its first native execution populated Start/End. Endpoint metadata still had zero XY; endpoint onChanged then replaced intended Points from those incomplete vectors. The resulting line/pipe was valid but misplaced. The BIM authoring order caused the actual failure and is already corrected in Oomakhi guidance; responsibility is not being transferred to FreeCAD.

Current source inspection at HEAD 85069f13d3edd995e84f354286c6226203644905: Draft.make_line delegates to make_wire, which assigns Points and returns without executing the wire. src/Mod/Draft/draftobjects/wire.py around lines 239-275 populates endpoints in execute/update_start_end; endpoint onChanged replaces Points from the endpoint vectors. Source review agrees with the retained native observation. A minimal current-runtime API reproduction and documented contract review remain outstanding.

Desired outcome: determine and document the supported sequence for creating a line, recomputing and attaching endpoint expressions. Consider immediate constructor endpoint initialization only if it preserves placements, existing documents and other Wire behaviour. Add focused native coverage for nonzero XY and component expressions if a source change is warranted.

Evidence in https://github.com/onobumba/oomakhi.git (available at commit 43423a05; local root /Users/zukomgwili/src/oomakhi):
- artifacts/BIM-Transition/r42/preparation/receiver-outlet-cause-and-bounded-repair.txt records the actual saved candidate: Line177 identity Placement and zero Start/End XY, Pipe185 more than 4484 mm from Wall033.
- docs/bim-transition/site-roof-drainage-r42.json records the checkpoint and partial qualification.
- skills/freecad-model-authoring/references/stock-bim-dependencies.md records constructor/recompute preflight.
- Originating building work oomakhi-q9f.13 and routing bead oomakhi-q9f.40. Native model repair and drawing acceptance remain in Oomakhi.

Verified stock recovery in that project: set complete public Start/End vectors, retain the two Z expressions, recompute the affected stock objects and inspect actual world vertices/contacts. This is not a general proof that component-expression attachment before first execution is supported. No FreeCAD source or constructor was changed. Further investigation belongs to the separate source session.
acceptance_criteria: Establish the supported stock constructor/recompute/expression sequence with a minimal nonzero-XY line. Document endpoint initialization timing and add focused coverage; if constructor behaviour is changed, preserve existing Wire placement, serialization and expression behaviour. Do not classify the Oomakhi authoring-order error as a confirmed regression.
